programs.title: Would You Kill for Me? The Mary Bailey Story
programs.desc: The lives of three generations of women take a turn for the worse when one of them becomes trapped in a toxic relationship with an increasingly abusive man.

programs.title: Gaslit by My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story
programs.desc: After a masked intruder assaults Morgan Metzer in her home, her ex-husband, Rodney, shows up minutes later. Questioned by the authorities, Rodney's story doesn't seem to add up, making him the prime suspect in the attack.

programs.title: Left for Dead: The Ashley Reeves Story
programs.desc: Left for dead in the woods after a brutal attack, 17-year-old Ashley Reeves must learn to walk and talk again while trying to remember who tried to kill her.

programs.title: The Killer Inside: The Ruth Finley Story
programs.desc: The kidnapping and sudden reappearance of Ruth Finley leaves investigators scrambling for answers. As suspicion mounts and new evidence comes to light, authorities entertain the notion that the perpetrator may be someone intimately connected to her.

programs.title: Husband, Father, Killer: The Alyssa Pladl Story
programs.desc: As a teen, Alyssa has a relationship with abusive Steven, but their path takes a dark turn after she has his child and gives her up for adoption. Years later, their daughter seeks them out, and Steven manipulates her into an affair.

programs.title: Monster in the Family: The Stacey Kananen Story
programs.desc: Stacey survives a childhood of abuse and fear, only to face a shocking twist when her brother, Rickie, tells her that he killed their parents. She soon faces further betrayal and legal trouble when Rickie claims that she helped him commit the crimes.
